label: Basic
description: Basic breadcrumb. Best for plain text levels split by the default chevron, with no icons, menus or custom styling.

label: Dropdown Menu
description: Breadcrumb with a menu of hidden levels. Best for middle levels folded into an ellipsis button that opens a menu of the hidden pages.

label: Router Link
description: Breadcrumb with router links. Best for levels whose press calls your router, the place to wire Expo Router's navigation.

label: Slash Separator
description: Breadcrumb with a custom slash separator. Best for slash characters between levels in place of the default chevron, on an otherwise plain trail.

label: Item Icons
description: Breadcrumb with icons for each item. Best for a leading icon on every level including the current screen, laid out beside each label.

label: Static Ellipsis
description: Breadcrumb with ellipsis for long paths. Best for a static ellipsis standing in for skipped middle levels, with no menu or link behind it.

label: Avatars
description: Breadcrumb items with avatars. Best for team and user levels led by small avatar images with initials fallbacks, ending on a plain current screen.

label: Double Chevron
description: Breadcrumb with double chevron separators. Best for double chevron icons passed into each separator in place of the single default one.

label: In Card
description: Breadcrumb on a card. Best for a trail on a padded card surface, opening with a home glyph and ending on a semibold current page.

label: Pill In Frame
description: Pill breadcrumb. Best for a trail in a tight rounded frame, with a home glyph and a semibold last level.

label: Count Badge
description: Breadcrumb items containing badge with count. Best for a rounded count badge inside a parent level, here a total of 3 beside the Inbox folder of a mail path.

label: Home Icon Button
description: Breadcrumb starting with a home button. Best for a square home icon button before the trail, its label kept for screen readers.

label: Bar Separator
description: Breadcrumb with a bar separator. Best for a short faded bar between levels in place of a character or icon.

label: Button Style
description: Button-style breadcrumb. Best for every level as a small button pairing an icon with its label, ghost for parent pages and filled for the current one.

label: Project & Document
description: Breadcrumb with project, user and document info. Best for two line levels pairing an avatar or tinted file tile with a name above a muted email or file name.
